name: QRecebe – QR Code & Copia e Cola Payments with Pix for WooCommerce
author: wooglobalapps

sections.description:
QRecebe adds Pix as a payment method to your WooCommerce store using only your Pix key: no payment provider account, no API keys and no fees charged by the plugin. Pix is the instant payment system of the Central Bank of Brazil (Banco Central do Brasil).

QRecebe is an independent plugin developed by WooGlobal Apps. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the Central Bank of Brazil (owner of the Pix brand) or WooCommerce / Automattic. “Pix” is used only to describe the payment method the plugin works with.

After the customer places the order, QRecebe shows a QR code and the “Pix copia e cola” code with the exact order amount. The customer pays in any Brazilian bank app, you see the money in your account and confirm the order with one click.

Features

  • Pix payment method for WooCommerce, compatible with the classic checkout and the Checkout block.
  • Static Pix code (BR Code) generated locally following the Central Bank of Brazil specification, with the order amount, receiver name, city, transaction ID (PIX + order number) and CRC16 checksum.
  • Works with all Pix key types: CPF, CNPJ, email, phone and random key.
  • QR code rendered in the customer’s browser by a bundled library: no external QR code services.
  • Copy button for the copy-and-paste code.
  • QR code and code on the thank you page and on the My Account order page.
  • Copy-and-paste code, amount and a link to the order page in the customer “on hold” email.
  • Optional Pix discount (percentage of the products subtotal), shown in the totals of the classic checkout and of the Cart/Checkout blocks.
  • Confirm Pix payment order action and orders list button: the order goes to Processing and a note is added.
  • Custom instructions, order status after checkout (On hold or Pending payment) and an informational payment deadline.
  • Generate with AI: describe what you want (a setting, a design change, texts, a custom feature) in the plugin screen and the AI assistant answers in the same chat.
  • Compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).
  • Translation ready.
  • Help screen under WooCommerce → QRecebe with setup tips, a welcome screen after the first activation and optional links to free setup help.

How payment confirmation works

QRecebe generates a static Pix code. Static Pix codes do not notify your store automatically: check that the payment arrived in your bank app (the transaction ID starts with PIX and the order number), then open the order and choose Confirm Pix payment.

Em português

QRecebe adiciona o pagamento com Pix à sua loja WooCommerce usando apenas a sua chave Pix: sem conta em intermediador, sem API e sem taxa cobrada pelo plugin. Depois do pedido, o cliente vê o QR Code Pix e o código Pix Copia e Cola com o valor exato, paga no app do banco e você confirma o pedido com um clique.

  • Pagamento com Pix no checkout clássico e no bloco de Checkout.
  • QR Code e Pix Copia e Cola (BR Code estático) gerados no seu próprio site, seguindo a especificação do Banco Central, com valor, nome, cidade e ID da transação (PIX + número do pedido).
  • Todas as chaves Pix: CPF, CNPJ, e-mail, telefone e chave aleatória.
  • Desconto no Pix opcional, exibido no carrinho e no checkout.
  • Botão Confirmar pagamento Pix no pedido e na lista de pedidos.
  • QR Code na página de obrigado, em Minha conta e o código no e-mail do pedido.
  • Compatível com HPOS. Gratuito, sem serviços externos no checkout e sem rastreamento.
  • Gerar com IA: descreva o que você quer na tela do plugin e o assistente de IA responde no mesmo chat.

O QRecebe é um plugin independente da WooGlobal Apps, sem vínculo com o Banco Central do Brasil (titular da marca Pix) ou com o WooCommerce / Automattic.

External services

This plugin connects to the WooGlobal Apps assistant service (https://conexao-support.vercel.app) only when an administrator uses the “Generate with AI” tab:

  • When you click Send, the plugin sends your message, your site address, the email you typed (optional), your site name and language and the plugin version, so the answer can be delivered back to your site.
  • While the “Generate with AI” tab is open, and only after you have sent a message, the plugin loads the conversation from the service.
  • When you delete the plugin, it asks the service to delete your conversation.

Nothing is sent from your store front, from your customers or before you click Send. Terms: https://wooglobal-apps.vercel.app/terms.html — Privacy policy: https://wooglobal-apps.vercel.app/privacy.html

Support & free setup

Questions and bug reports: use the support forum.

If you prefer, we install and configure QRecebe on your store for free. The Help and Hire us tabs (next to the Generate with AI tab) under WooCommerce → QRecebe and the plugin row on the Plugins screen have links that open WhatsApp with a message containing only the plugin name and version, and a link to our website with optional paid services (for example automatic Pix confirmation through a payment provider or checkout optimization).

These are plain links: nothing is sent unless you click them and send the message yourself. QRecebe works fully without them: every feature is free and nothing is locked. A single dismissible notice (Dashboard and Plugins screens only, 7 days after activation) offers the same help and a link to rate the plugin.

Third-party libraries

  • QR Code Generator for JavaScript by Kazuhiko Arase, version 2.0.4, MIT license (https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator), bundled in assets/js/qrcode.js.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the qrecebe folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  3. Activate QRecebe.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Pix (QRecebe).
  5. Choose the key type, enter your Pix key, the receiver name and the city exactly as registered in your bank, enable the method and save.
sections.faq:
Is QRecebe an official Pix or WooCommerce plugin?

No. QRecebe is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the Central Bank of Brazil (Banco Central do Brasil), owner of the Pix brand, or by WooCommerce / Automattic.

Is the payment confirmed automatically?

No. QRecebe uses a static Pix code, which does not send a payment notification to your store. When the money arrives in your bank account, confirm the order with Order actions → Confirm Pix payment or with the button in the orders list. Automatic confirmation requires a payment provider (dynamic Pix) and is not part of this plugin.

Does QRecebe send my data or my customers’ data anywhere?

No. The Pix code and the QR code are generated on your own site and in the customer’s browser. The payment flow does not contact any external server, API or QR code service. The only connection to an external server is the optional “Generate with AI” tab, and only when an administrator clicks Send (see “External services”).

Do I need an account with a payment company?

No. You only need a Pix key registered in your bank account.

Which Pix keys are supported?

CPF, CNPJ, email, phone (with area code; the +55 country code is added automatically) and random key (EVP).

Why are accents removed from the name and city?

The Pix standard accepts only plain characters and limits the receiver name to 25 characters and the city to 15 characters. QRecebe converts them automatically.

How does the Pix discount work?

Set a percentage in the settings. When the customer selects Pix, a negative fee “Pix discount” is added, calculated on the products subtotal after coupons (shipping is not discounted). The QR code amount already includes the discount.

Does it work with the Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. Pix appears in the Checkout block and the discount is shown in the block totals when Pix is selected.

Can the customer see the QR code later?

Yes. The QR code stays available on the order page in My Account (and through the link in the email) while the order is On hold or Pending payment.

What can I ask in “Generate with AI”?

Anything related to your store and this plugin: settings, design changes, texts and translations, or a custom feature. The answer appears in the same chat, usually within a few hours.
